nodes.title: Part C
nodes.summary: The text describes Part C, Section 1 (Benefits) of the HDFC Life Click 2 Protect Optima Secure policy bond. It details the Life & CI Rebalance option, where the Basic Sum Assured is split between Life Cover SA (initially 80%) and CI SA (initially 20%), with CI SA increasing and Life Cover SA decreasing annually by 30% × Basic Sum Assured ÷ Policy Term, keeping the total Basic Sum Assured constant. An example with 50 lakhs Basic Sum Assured and 10-year term illustrates the yearly changes. After a Critical Illness claim, Life Cover SA is fixed. It also covers Death Benefit (lump sum if death occurs during policy term with all premiums paid, being the highest of Sum Assured on Death, 105% of Total Premiums Paid, or Life Cover SA; Sum Assured on Death defined differently for Single Pay vs. Other than Single Pay), Critical Illness Benefit (payable CI SA on diagnosis, future premiums waived, life cover continues, definitions in Appendix 1), and Maturity Benefit (Sum Assured on Maturity equal to total premiums paid if Return Of Premium option selected, otherwise Nil). The document is dated 8th November 2024 and is page 9 of 43.

nodes.title: Annexure III
nodes.summary: This text from the HDFC Life Click 2 Protect Optima Secure policy bond presents Annexure III, detailing Section 45 of the Insurance Act, 1938, as amended in 2015. It outlines that no life insurance policy can be questioned after three years from the latest of policy issuance, risk commencement, revival, or rider date, except on fraud grounds within three years, requiring written communication with grounds and materials. Fraud is defined as intentional deception by the insured or agent, including false suggestions, concealment, or deceptive acts, while mere silence isn't fraud unless there's a duty to speak. Insurers cannot repudiate for fraud if misstatement was true to best knowledge or known to insurer, with onus on policyholder/beneficiaries. Policies can be questioned within three years for material misstatements affecting life expectancy, with written communication, and if repudiated for non-fraud misstatement, premiums are refunded within 90 days. Materiality requires direct risk bearing, onus on insurer, and age proof can be requested anytime without questioning the policy. A disclaimer notes this is a simplified version, advising reference to the full Act, with document dating and page numbering.
